result_preview.title: Segment-Driven Campaign Optimizer Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: AI agent that autonomously identifies high-value customer segments and optimizes campaign targeting and messaging.
result_preview.description: This agent continuously analyzes CustomerSegment performance data and engagement metrics to recommend real-time campaign optimizations. It evaluates segment characteristics against Campaign performance indicators, automatically adjusts audience targeting parameters, and generates personalized messaging recommendations. The agent reduces manual campaign tuning effort while improving conversion rates through data-driven segment-to-campaign alignment.

result_preview.title: Campaign Audience Optimization Coordinator
result_preview.shortDescription: Monitors and optimizes campaign performance across customer segments in real time.
result_preview.description: Automatically coordinates campaign execution by monitoring audience engagement patterns across customer segments and accounts. Processes segmentation criteria to identify high-value targets and dynamically adjusts campaign strategies based on performance metrics. Orchestrates real-time audience refinement to maximize campaign ROI and ensures optimal resource allocation across marketing initiatives.

result_preview.title: Campaign Contact Engagement API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages real-time contact engagement states and campaign interactions across channels.
result_preview.description: Provides programmatic access to campaign contact engagement data, enabling retrieval and management of customer interaction states throughout omnichannel journey orchestration. Exposes contact engagement records linked to campaigns and customer accounts to support real-time personalization and journey state tracking across marketing touchpoints.
